newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian gold ends lower after promising opening.
newsitem.headline: Indian gold ends lower after promising opening.

text.p: Indian gold prices ended lower on Friday after opening on a bright note as improved supplies and lower than expected seasonal buying dragged down the market, dealers said.
"Weak trends in the world market as well as reports than the government may liberalise the gold import policy in India also triggered fresh offerings," one dealer said.
Prices of a gold biscuit (116.50 grammes) slid by 200 rupees to close at 59,550 rupees.
Silver also opened higher but fresh arrivals of about 3,000 kg of imported silver trimmed early gains by the the close.
